{{Top|leg}}
'''Ufflor of Ufflors''' was the title given to [[Ugnor]] by the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] of the [[Ugnaught Mechanics Union]] residing on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. When dealing with other guilds on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], the head [[ufflor officer]] spoke as a single voice for the three tribes:<ref name="ActionTidings2">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20041007bespin2|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 2: That Den o' Human Iniquity}}</ref> [[Irden]], [[Botrut]], and [[Isced]].<ref name="ActionTidings1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040930bespin1|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 1: Live From the Surface}}</ref>
